title: Add Admin Dashboard And Kubernetes Cluster
description:
Add an admin dashboard to compose/server so server admins can see users (persons), kits, active connections, sessions, share tokens, and configure the server (history/compaction) directly. Provide a complete Kubernetes cluster manifest (Namespace, PostgreSQL StatefulSet, compose-session Deployment, repo web Deployment, Ingress with dashboard routing) covering all moving parts of the stack. Also update compose.yml to expose the admin token and dashboard path.

Server changes (compose/server/bin.rs):
- New admin module with bearer-token auth (env: COMPOSE_ADMIN_TOKEN)
- Track active WebSocket connection counts per session in SessionDirectory
- Endpoints:
  - GET /admin                  - embedded HTML dashboard
  - GET /admin/overview         - summary counts + uptime
  - GET /admin/sessions         - list all sessions with metadata + active connections
  - GET /admin/sessions/{id}    - detailed session with kit/persons/share tokens
  - POST /admin/sessions/{id}/passivate - drop in-memory actor
  - POST /admin/sessions/{id}/close     - update session status to closed
  - GET /admin/kits             - all kits across sessions
  - GET /admin/persons          - all connected/present persons
  - GET /admin/share-tokens     - all share tokens
  - DELETE /admin/share-tokens/{token} - revoke a share token
  - GET /admin/connections      - in-memory active sessions with WS counts
  - GET /admin/config/{session_id}   - current compaction configuration
  - PATCH /admin/config/{session_id} - update compaction retention configuration
- Embedded responsive single-file HTML dashboard with tabs

Infrastructure:
- New compose/server/k8s.yaml with full cluster
- compose.yml updated with admin token env and dashboard access
summary:
Shipped a server admin surface on compose-session and a full Kubernetes manifest.

Backend (compose/server/bin.rs):
- New admin module with COMPOSE_ADMIN_TOKEN bearer auth; endpoints: GET /admin (embedded dashboard HTML), /admin/overview, /admin/sessions, /admin/sessions/{id}, /admin/kits, /admin/persons, /admin/share-tokens, /admin/connections, /admin/config/{session_id}; POST /admin/sessions/{id}/passivate, /admin/sessions/{id}/close; DELETE /admin/share-tokens/{token}; PATCH /admin/config/{session_id}.
- SessionHandle/SessionDirectory now expose active WS connection counts and uptime via ActiveSessionInfo / list_active / active_session_count / total_active_connections, wired from ws_handler using an atomic counter with Drop-guard decrement.
- Embedded single-file responsive dashboard HTML (DASHBOARD_HTML) with token sign-in, live overview, tabbed views (sessions, kits, persons, share tokens, connections, compaction config) that polls endpoints every 5s.

Tests (bin.rs tests module):
- Unit tests for require_admin: rejects when token unset (403), missing bearer (401), wrong bearer (401), accepts correct bearer.
- Unit test for SessionHandle atomic connection counter.
- New E2E test e2e_admin_endpoints_with_postgres using testcontainers Postgres: seeds two sessions, creates a share token, exercises overview/sessions/session-detail/kits/share-tokens/persons/connections, asserts 401 without token, validates compaction config read+PATCH (including rejection of unknown lookback tokens with 400), closes a session and verifies status='closed', passivate endpoint, and that /admin returns embedded HTML.
- Verified: cargo check --bin compose-session (clean), cargo test --bin compose-session require_admin (4/4 passing), session_directory_tracks_active_connections (1/1 passing).

Infrastructure:
- New compose/server/k8s.yaml: Namespace compose, ConfigMap+Secret, Postgres StatefulSet (PVC, healthchecks, init configmap), compose-session Deployment (Recreate, tcp probes) with COMPOSE_ADMIN_TOKEN wired from Secret, repo web Deployment (2 replicas, shared PVC), worker Deployment, blob PVC, Ingress routing /admin, /sessions*, /ws* to session:8788 and / to web:8787 with websocket-friendly timeouts.
- compose.yml: session service now requires COMPOSE_ADMIN_TOKEN, binds 127.0.0.1:8788, adds RUST_LOG and tcp healthcheck, unified LISTEN_ADDR.
- repo/server/Caddyfile: path-based reverse proxy for /admin, /sessions, /ws to session:8788, default to web:8787.
